journey.name: usdt send review and details
journey.description: Use an onboarded wallet with USDT, a fresh BTC/USD rate, an owned recipient and existing sent/received activity. Quotes require the service with MAX support. No payment is submitted.

actions.action: Enable USDT in the introductory sheet or Settings, General, Payments before starting this flow.

Open USDT Send and enter the owned recipient. On Amount, verify the BTC equivalent above the dollar amount, 32-point gap before Available balance, USDT badge, MAX and network pill. Enter a six-decimal amount and verify no precision is lost. With a large available balance and BNB Smart Chain selected, verify both values remain fully readable; the controls may wrap onto a second row.

Open the network pill and verify the full USDT Network picker, Tether rows and selected teal check. Select another EVM network. Verify the amount and valid recipient remain. Change to Solana with an EVM recipient and verify recipient entry is required. Enter an owned plain Solana address and verify the previous amount remains. Return to Arbitrum, enter the owned EVM address and verify the amount still remains.

From recipient entry with another network selected, paste an explicit Arbitrum USDT URI. Verify the selected network becomes Arbitrum and the link amount is retained. A plain 0x address preserves the selected network.
Tap MAX. Verify it fills a positive amount below the balance and remains on Amount. Continue and verify the payment plus maximum fee fits within the balance. Back out without swiping.

Enter a smaller amount and continue. Verify the collapsed review shows the amount, coin illustration, Show Details and teal Swipe To Pay. Show Details reveals Pay from, Network, Payment, Fee and Address. Verify Network is Arbitrum One and the fee note says all fees are paid in USDT and the final fee may be lower. Displayed amounts round to cents; nonzero values below one cent show <0.01. Hide Details restores the illustration. Cancel without paying.

Prepare an ordinary amount and note the payment and fee in Details. Go back to Amount and immediately continue without editing; verify the same review values return. Go back, change the amount and continue; verify the payment reflects the new amount. Go back, wait until the quote expires (at most two minutes) and continue; verify a new quote is obtained or an error leaves the amount editable, rather than displaying expired fees. Cancel without swiping.

Prepare a cross-network payment and continue. Verify the basic confirmation shows the amount, coin illustration, Show Details and teal Swipe To Pay without Recipient gets or Max total debit rows. Tap Show Details (id "UsdtReviewDetails"). Verify the two-column rows are Pay from / Network, Payment / Fee, Recipient gets / Max total debit and Address / Recipient network. Network must be Arbitrum One; Recipient network must be the chosen destination. Verify Recipient gets (id "UsdtRecipientAmount") follows the quote, with an approximation marker for Orchestra, and Max total debit (id "UsdtMaximumTotal") equals the payment plus maximum fee. Tap the shortened address (id "UsdtReviewAddress") and verify the full value is shown and can be selected and copied. Tap again to restore the compact row. Hide Details restores the basic confirmation. Cancel without paying.

Using the local quote fixture, prepare a 5 USDT bridge with 2 USDT received and a small network fee. Try to proceed and verify the fee-over-half-value warning appears before payment authentication. Cancel without paying.

Open an existing sent USDT activity. Verify the heading is Sent USDT, the signed amount includes the actual fee, and summary rows show Status/Network, Date/Time and Payment/Fee with teal icons. Open Details and verify transaction ID, known sender, recipient and source/destination networks; Open Block Explorer stays at the bottom.

Open an existing received activity. Verify Received USDT and a positive amount. Verify Details shows the verified sender when available and does not invent one for older unknown records. Check pending, failed and transferring rows use their matching icons, and transferring shows its destination.

Prepare a contact payment that accepts multiple payment methods. Open the payment-source button and verify the balance menu shows Savings, Spending, any paired hardware wallet and USDT. Unsupported methods are disabled and shown at 30% opacity. Verify the menu has 24px outer padding, 24px asset icons, 13/18 uppercase labels and 17/22 balances, with no extra transfer icon next to Spending. Select a supported method and verify its label, available balance and payable amount update. Cancel without paying.
